sets.name: same label in two menus: the command holding the key wins
sets.xml:
﻿<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<photoshop-keyboard-shortcuts version="4" filename="$$$/FileName/Presets/KeyboardCustomization/texcuts=texcuts">
	<command kind="static" name="Levels..."><shortcut>Cmd+L</shortcut></command>
	<command kind="static" name="Gaussian Blur..."><shortcut>F9</shortcut></command>
</photoshop-keyboard-shortcuts>
sets.differs: PhotoCraft picks among commands sharing a label by the key it finds (the one whose default is among the row's keys, else the first with a default); plan reports the row as unmatched (ambiguous) and the user picks the command.
